queries.viewership_stats:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(reqTimeSec, 'Asia/Kolkata')) AS report_date,
 round(countIf(reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND reqPath NOT LIKE '%.m3u8' AND statusCode IN (200, 206) AND extract(reqPath, '[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != '')*6.0/3600.0,2) AS viewership_hours,
 if(uniqIf(cliIP, (reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND reqPath NOT LIKE '%.m3u8' AND statusCode IN (200, 206) AND extract(reqPath, '[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != '') AND channel_name != '')=0,0,
 round(countIf((reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND reqPath NOT LIKE '%.m3u8' AND statusCode IN (200, 206) AND extract(reqPath, '[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != '') AND channel_name != '')*6.0/60.0/
 nullIf(uniqIf(cliIP, (reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND reqPath NOT LIKE '%.m3u8' AND statusCode IN (200, 206) AND extract(reqPath, '[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != '') AND channel_name != ''),0),2)) AS avg_watch_minutes,
 countIf(reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND statusCode IN (200,206) AND extract(reqPath,'[-_](\d+)\.ts$') != '') AS total_segments,
 sumIf(bytes, reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND statusCode IN (200, 206)) AS bandwidth_bytes
 FROM Veto_Streamin.logs WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(1792866600, 'UTC') AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(1792953000, 'UTC') GROUP BY report_date ORDER BY report_date SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60
